title: Hoppers (Appam)
description: Hoppers (Appam) is a Sri Lanka dish made with white rice, coconut milk, instant yeast, chicken egg. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the listed rice, grains or noodles in clean water for about 240 minutes as appropriate, then drain; grind rice and urad for batter if required by this dish.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Leave the mixed rice-and-legume batter loosely covered in a clean warm place for about 300 minutes until aerated and tangy. Fermentation times vary; avoid overheating.
Swirl coconut-rice batter up the sides of a small hopper pan; for egg hoppers, crack an egg into the center and cover until fully set.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
